lines.zh: 我四脚爬着走，翅膀贴着身侧。
lines.en: I go on four legs with my wings folded in.
I move as if gliding over the ground.

lines.zh: 我从峡谷的石壁上跑过。
lines.en: I run along the canyon wall.
I stretch my head to sniff as I go.
One hop clears the crevice.

lines.zh: 我在 Sacilite 的石头上走。
lines.en: I walk the Sacilite stone.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀半开着，保持平衡。
lines.en: My wings are half open for balance.
I keep low along the ground.
I walk in the canyon's shade.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓在石上，很稳。
lines.en: My claws take the stone firmly.

lines.zh: 我从高处滑下来，落在低处。
lines.en: I glide down and land lower.
My head swings side to side.
I go along the canyon rim.
I am not hurried, but there is strength in it.

lines.zh: 我伏在石头上，翅膀收着。
lines.en: I lie on the stone with my wings tucked.
My ears turn.
I am listening to the canyon's echo.

lines.zh: 这地方很干，石头都发红。
lines.en: It is dry here; the stone is red.
I lift my head and look at the sky.
Four legs planted, like a bat.
I shivered my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 我在等一群里其他的回来。
lines.en: I am waiting for the rest of the group.
My claws are tucked under me.
The wind runs through the canyon.
I blinked my eyes slowly.
I dislike being alone.
I raise my head and look right at you.
You are standing by my stone.
I tipped my head a little.
Your smell is unfamiliar.
I stand and spread my wings.

lines.zh: 我收起翼膜，歪头打量你。
lines.en: I fold my wing membrane and tilt my head at you.
I did not make a single sound.
If you move, I need to watch.
I watch you from two paces off.
Your shadow falls before my feet.
I lie back down.
I spread my wings so you see me clearly.
I claimed this stone first.
I turn and draw my wings in.
That hurt somewhat.
I fell back behind that stone.
I tilt my head, teeth still showing.
I set all four legs straight again.

lines.zh: 我嗓子里滚出一声长叫。
lines.en: A long call rolled out of my throat.
My leg trembled.

lines.zh: 蝙蝠翅膀收起来，慢慢缓。
lines.en: My bat wings fold, and I recover slowly.

lines.zh: 我的翼膜破了个口，我嘶叫。
lines.en: A hole tears in my wing membrane, and I hiss.
I did not leave this stone.

lines.zh: 你手里的零食，让我收起尖牙。
lines.en: The treat in your hand makes me sheath my fangs.

lines.zh: 那味道是那种驯服点心。
lines.en: That smell is those taming treats.

lines.zh: 这点零食，只够我舔一下。
lines.en: That treat is barely a lick.
Hand over a few more.
You still have a few in your hand.
That smell eases me.
A little more and I will stay.

lines.zh: 那块 Tremor Treats，闻着像家。
lines.en: That Tremor Treat smells like home.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我侧了一下身。
lines.en: You hit me and I turn slightly.
I brace my wings and give half a step.
That much knocking does not count.
I cocked my head and sized you up.
My claws hold the ground.
All four legs have got their grip back.
You nearly tripped over yourself.
I am standing in front of the stone.
Do not crowd me against the stone.
I move aside.

lines.zh: 你撞到我侧肋，我甩了一下尾。
lines.en: You hit my flank and my tail flicks.
Only in season do I do this.
I walked most of a circle around it.
My wings spread, then close.
I nip its neck softly.
The canyon is quiet.
Afterwards we are still a group.
It nuzzles my head.

lines.zh: 我们倒挂在岩檐下，翼膜相碰。
lines.en: We hang side by side under the rock lip, wings touching.
I took it in one bite.
This is not food.

lines.zh: 啃完这些糖块，我才听你的。
lines.en: After these treats, I will obey.
I chew on it a while.
This is hard enough to crack teeth.

lines.zh: 我一爪按住它，低头闻了闻。
lines.en: I pin it under a claw and sniff.
I sniff and drop it.
I carry it to a herdmate.
This one is mine now.
This one is mine to keep.
I raise my head, wings half open.
You struck the first blow.

lines.zh: 岩壁上的影子一缩，那是我。
lines.en: The shadow on the cliff shrinks; that is me.
I have you fixed in my eye.
I came down off the stone.
I pushed my front foot out.
I show my teeth.
Wings spread — I've got my eyes on you.
I follow you in light steps.

lines.zh: 我贴着崖壁滑行，跟着你的转向。
lines.en: I glide along the cliff and mirror your turn.
I glide down from over the canyon.
I keep myself low.
I am in no hurry; the canyon is only so long.
Wherever you run, it is stone.
My wings stay half open.
I run along the canyon wall.
I can hear your steps clearly.
I drew in another half step.

lines.zh: 我俯冲下来，后爪先碰到你。
lines.en: I swoop down, hind claws striking first.
I spring, wings braced.
That one came from a distance.
All four feet landed steady.
That struck you.
I pull back and crouch.
My claws rake across.
That blow drove you back.

lines.zh: 我从峡谷的石缝里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a fissure in the canyon.

lines.zh: 我先伸出翅膀，然后是头。
lines.en: My wings show first, then my head.

lines.zh: 石头响了一下，我就到了。
lines.en: Stone grated, and there I was.

lines.zh: 这一带是 Sacilite 的石头。
lines.en: This is Sacilite stone.
I land on the red rock.
The canyon is no longer empty.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把风闻了一遍。
lines.en: I raised my head and tasted the wind.

lines.zh: 我身边的同伴也上来了。
lines.en: My herdmates come up too.
It is cooler here than the old place.
I flatten and run.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的翅膀，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my wing; I beat it out.

lines.zh: 我落地的冲击传遍四条腿。
lines.en: The landing jolts through all four legs.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我扑腾着往外爬。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I flounder out.
The blast flips me onto the stone.

lines.zh: 一股力把我的身体定住。
lines.en: Some force holds my body still.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我背上，四腿一起锁住。
lines.en: Lightning hit my back and locked all four legs at once.

lines.zh: 脚下没有石头，我抓不牢。
lines.en: There is no stone and my claws find nothing.
